Beginning in 1948, as part of the persecution of [ENTITY-5] during the last chapter of Stalin's rule (for example, the "Doctors' plot"), most prominent members of the JAC were arrested on trumped-up spying charges, tortured, and tried in secret proceedings. In 1952, many were executed in the basement of Lubyanka Prison. They were officially rehabilitated in 1988.
